method.scenes: Methane molecules (C-H 1.09 angstrom) on a simple cubic lattice, 4.1 angstrom apart: five atoms and four bonds per molecule, chemically valid.
method.camera: The camera orbits the scene at 0.8 rad/s, one pose per animation frame, with the whole scene in view. 3500 ms warm-up, then 4000 ms measured.
method.pacing: Intervals between animation frames, which the browser caps at the refresh rate of the display. CPU and GPU times are per frame, medians, from the application's own monitor (GPU time from EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 where the browser exposes it).
method.resolution: The application lowers the pixel ratio by itself when frames run long; the pixel ratio in force at the end of each run is reported.
method.statistics: Every configuration of the large scenes was measured 3 times, once in each of 3 passes over all scenes, so that the measurements of one configuration lie minutes apart. The tables give the run with the middle frame rate and, beside it, the frame rate of every run in the order measured. The single timings (building, editing) are the middle one of the 3 passes. The typical molecule and the orbit during a calculation were measured three times in a row.
